text:
Priya K: hey team — heads up i'm OOO fri 12:00-18:00 PT. i'll still be reachable for critical pages but i can't take primary for the late-afternoon overlap. there's a coverage gap for the 16:00-20:00 PT window that touches APAC handoffs :wave:

Alex M: noted. is this the usual spike window we see on deploys? or a one-off this week? :eyes:

Priya K: it's the usual deploy-window for product A, plus a scheduled batch job that hits our embeddings service. expecting elevated 95th latency. not a huge risk but would prefer a designated primary + shadow for that block.

Jorge R: i can flex and cover primary for 16:00-18:30 PT, but need someone to shadow for the first page handoffs (i'm on call in eu evening after 19:00). Samira you around to take shadow for the first hour?

Samira L: yup can do 16:00-17:00 PT shadow. want a quick walkthrough beforehand — 15m pairing? :thumbsup:

Priya K: that'd be ideal. 15:30 PT pairing to run through runbook & hot paths. please follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-orientation — short checklist under "new shadow". main things: escalation matrix, PD incident channels, and wallet of quick fixes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: test page scheduled 2026-03-15T16:05:00Z for rotation verification.

Alex M: here's the minimal rotation commands I use for PD (only ops team admins):
```bash
# add shadow temporarily
pd rotation add --rotation "eng-oncall-weekend" --user "Samira L" --start "2026-03-13T23:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-14T01:00:00Z"
# set primary override for window
pd escalation-policy override --policy "redwood-prod" --user "Jorge R" --start "2026-03-13T23:00:00Z" --end "2026-03-14T01:30:00Z"
```

Jorge R: Samira, when shadowing, check these quick commands in runbook for common issues:
- check the inference pool health: `curl -sS http://infra-api/internal/pools | jq .`
- inspect recent millis: `redis-cli -h cache01 HGET summary embeddings_latency`
- quick rollback of model route: see console -> Routes -> rollback to v2026-03-10 (takes ~30s)

Samira L: got it. can you also paste the small checklist for "first page" response? i want the script to follow during page.

Priya K: paste from runbook (shortened):
1) ack page in PD within 2m and paste PD link to #incidents
2) check console route health + token spend (Console -> Metrics)
3) if latency > 1s 95th, switch to smaller batch config (runbook has exact curl)
4) if errors >= 5% for 5m, failover to fallback-model v2 (manual until auto-rollout confirmed)

oncall-bot: INCIDENT TEST: test-page received from PD. No escalation required.

Alex M: scheduling note: Priya — i'll take the 18:30-20:00 shift so Jorge can take EU evening. i'll add the temporary pd overrides and ping ops-admins in 15m.

Samira L: 15:30 PT pairing sounds good. can we do 30m just to run through a fake page scenario? want to practice the dialogue: who says what when we handoff.

Priya K: 30m works. pls add calendar invite "oncall pairing: priya + samira" and include link to runbook. will prep a short incident-play doc.

Alex M: done — invite sent. i've posted the minimal pd commands and the runbook link into the invite description. :thumbsup:

Jorge R: thanks all. i'll update the oncall rota and leave a short note in the rota description about expected higher latency window. also logging this thread into the oncall-log for future onboarding notes.

Priya K: great — appreciate the help. Samira, we'll do the toy page in the pairing, you'll be primary observer first then escalate to Jorge after the first ack. any blockers call out here. :pray:

Samira L: no blockers. see you at 15:30 PT.
